cases.name: Esperanza Elizabeth "Espie" Chavez
cases.narrative: Unified Police homicide detectives say Edwards shot her in the head and then tried twice to put her in a garbage dumpster outside a business in Millcreek. Surveillance footage from a business, court documents show, captured Edwards in his truck attempting to dump Chavez in the dumpster. When he couldn’t, he then dropped her on the ground where she was later found leaning up against the dumpster.
